analyst_view.overall: Leeds are 7th, unbeaten in five home league games and coming off a 1-0 win over Tottenham and a 4-1 win at Chelsea; Daniel Farke has everyone fit except Mateo Joseph. Promoted Coventry are 14th, have only 3 points from 5 away games and have not kept a clean sheet in six. On Thursday Frank Lampard confirmed Taiwo Awoniyi has a 'significant' ankle injury and will miss this game, Haji Wright is still a few weeks away, Amenda is out and Caleb Yirenkyi and Ephron Mason-Clark are doubts. The numbers already count Awoniyi as out (about -10% on Coventry's goals) and Paul Tierney's slightly low card rate, so nothing new is left to size.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals: 1.8 for Leeds and 0.9 for Coventry. Lampard has now confirmed Awoniyi is out, which is exactly what the numbers assumed (about -10% on Coventry's goals), and Leeds' sharp attack and Coventry's leaky defence are already in recent form. Nothing new points either way, so I stay at about 2.7.

corners.text: The numbers expect 8.3 corners: 5.2 for Leeds and 3.2 for Coventry, already lowered because both have won fewer corners lately. Leeds' wide play and crosses fit the home side winning most of them, and Lampard says Coventry must match Leeds physically rather than change their approach, so I stay at about 8.3.

cards.text: The numbers expect 2.7 cards, already counting Leeds being booked more than usual lately, Coventry less, and Paul Tierney's slightly low rate (3.8 a game). Lampard spoke of a rivalry with Leeds fans from his Chelsea and Derby days, but it is not a derby between the clubs and there are no bans in play, so I stay at about 2.7.

shots.text: The numbers expect 28.1 shots, 18.5 from Leeds at home, which already includes Leeds shooting more than usual lately. Leeds have a fully fit attack apart from Joseph, and Coventry lose Awoniyi, which the numbers already assume, so I stay at about 28.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers expect 8.4 shots on target: 5.2 for Leeds and 3.2 for Coventry. Leeds' sharper finishing and Awoniyi's absence are both already counted; with Wright still weeks away Coventry rely on Cherif or Simms up front, which fits the low away figure, so I stay at about 8.4.
